FIFA President Infantino Open to Reform Talks After Backlash

FIFA President Gianni Infantino has stated he is open to direct, structured consultations with confederations, member associations, and stakeholders regarding FIFA's decision-making processes. This comes after a backlash and calls for his resignation following a failed project. Infantino proposed the FIFA Council establish these consultations. The German football chief, Neuendorf, described Infantino's reform letter as a re-election ploy.
